content:
Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez would like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. His calendar is quite full; the open slots within working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:

- Monday: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Tuesday: 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday: 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30

Which of these works best for you? (Thursday and Friday are fully booked on his end.) If you'd prefer a full hour, let me know and I can look at rearranging something.
Checking my calendar for next week and I’ll compare those windows now.
Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works best for me. If that slot ends up not working after all, Wednesday 10:00-10:30 would be my next choice.

I've got my calendar loaded for next week, but I'm not sure yet what we're coordinating. What are you looking to set up — a meeting between us, or are you trying to find a common free window for something specific? Let me know the day/duration and I'll compare against Professor Alvarez's schedule.
You were asking about the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Of the 30-minute windows you sent, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works best for me; if you need a backup, Wednesday 10:00-10:30 also works.
Booked! Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is confirmed on Professor Alvarez's calendar. Looking forward to it.
I’m adding the confirmed staff meeting to my calendar now.
All set — the CSE455 staff meeting is booked for Tuesday 15:00-15:30. I've confirmed it's clear on Professor Alvarez's side and added it to the calendar. See you then!
I’ve confirmed the edit I need to make and I’m updating next Tuesday’s block plus the booking log.
Thanks — I’ve added the CSE455 staff meeting to my calendar for Tuesday 15:00-15:30. Looking forward to it as well.
Thanks — it’s on my calendar as well. See you then!
